CareerMaker.ai Announces Bengaluru On-Site Assessment Research Intern Opening

03 Nov 2026, 08:23 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Editorial Desk · Source: in.linkedin.com

1 min read

Key takeawaysCareerMaker.ai has listed an opening for an on-site Assessment Research Intern based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. The role focuses on the product and assessment research department, centering on building foundational research for the organization's AI-powered assessment platforms.

In this article

CareerMaker.ai has listed an opening for an on-site Assessment Research Intern based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. The role focuses on the product and assessment research department, centering on building foundational research for the organization's AI-powered assessment platforms.

Role Overview and Responsibilities

The position involves studying and cataloging testing methodologies, question frameworks, evaluation models, and skill measurement approaches. According to the listing details, responsibilities include:

  • Researching aptitude, technical, domain, and behavioral assessment structures.
  • Analyzing testing formats, scoring methodologies, and difficulty calibrations.
  • Converting unstructured research information into structured, machine-readable datasets.
  • Collaborating with product and assessment teams to align findings with platform requirements.

Candidate Qualifications

The company outlines specific preferences for applicants interested in educational technology and evaluation systems:

  • Educational background in Arts, Humanities, Social Sciences, Psychology, Education, or related fields.
  • Strong reading comprehension, analytical capabilities, and information-gathering skills.
  • Familiarity with standard documentation and spreadsheet tools such as Google Docs and Excel.
  • Prior research experience is noted as a plus, though candidates with strong analytical skills without prior industry experience are also encouraged to apply.
